evidence: Clicked New Resume; editor opened with Untitled Resume title, empty Contact/Summary/Experience/Education/Skills tabs, and editing was immediately available.
Date inputs are native month pickers (YYYY-MM) consistent across start/end; checking 'I currently work here' cleared and disabled the End Date field and preview showed 'Jun 2018 - Present'.

issue: Invalid experience date ranges are not rejected
actual: Setting an experience End Date (2017-01) earlier than its Start Date (2018-06) was accepted with no error/validation message; preview rendered 'Jun 2018 - Jan 2017'. Setting End Date to a future date (2030-01) was likewise accepted with no rejection or feedback.

evidence: Entered contact details and summary; added two experience entries, reordered them via up/down arrows (order changed in preview); added an education entry; added two skills, changed React's level to Expert, and removed TypeScript. All changes reflected correctly in editor and live preview.

Throughout Contact, Summary, Experience, Education, and Skills edits, the Live Preview panel updated immediately after each field change/add/remove/reorder action with no manual save or page refresh required.
Switched between Modern, Classic, and Minimal templates; each changed the preview layout/styling distinctly while retaining all entered contact, summary, experience, education, and skills content.

In the Sections tab, toggled Education visibility off (removed from preview), reordered Skills above Work Experience via up-arrow (order changed in preview accordingly), and renamed 'Work Experience' heading to 'Career History' (preview updated).
Section reorder and visibility toggle changes updated the Live Preview immediately; the new order/layout persisted while switching templates and tabs within the session.
Renamed 'Work Experience' section heading to 'Career History'; the custom heading text appeared correctly in the preview for Minimal, Classic, and Modern styles.

Clicked 'Hide Preview' - preview panel disappeared and editor expanded, button became 'Show Preview'. Clicked 'Show Preview' - preview panel reappeared with all editor content (contact, summary, skills, experience, education) and Modern template intact.

issue: No validation feedback shown when renaming to blank title
actual: Editing the resume title to a whitespace-only value and pressing Enter silently reverted the title back to 'Untitled Resume' with no visible error, toast, or inline validation message indicating why the change was rejected.

evidence: Renamed resume title to 'QA Test Resume - Software Engineer' in editor; the same title appeared in the editor header and on the dashboard card after returning to the dashboard.

After navigating between editor tabs, returning to dashboard, and reopening the resume, Contact (Jane Tester, email, phone, location), Summary, Experience (2 entries), Education (State University), and Skills (React) all remained intact.
Edits (rename, content) were retained automatically without explicit save; dashboard card showed 'Updated Aug 25, 2026' reflecting the change, and reopening the resume showed all edits preserved.

Added 4 experience entries plus summary/education/skills causing preview content (2018px) to exceed viewport (720px). All visible sections (Summary, Skills, Career History with all 4 positions, Education) rendered in the DOM; scrolling (window.scrollTo) reached the bottom content (Education/State University), confirming the full resume remains readable via scrolling.

Duplicated 'Untitled Resume' (Full Name='Original Person') via '...' menu, producing 'Untitled Resume (Copy)'. Renamed the copy to 'Copy Person Resume' via the Rename dialog. Edited the copy's Full Name to 'Copied Person Edited' - source resume's Full Name remained 'Original Person' when reopened, confirming independent editing of the duplicate without altering the source.

Bidirectional test: (1) Edited copy's Full Name to 'Copied Person Edited' - reopened original, still showed 'Original Person' (unaffected). (2) Edited original's Full Name to 'Original Person Modified' - reopened copy, still showed 'Copied Person Edited' (unaffected). Confirms duplicate and original are fully independent data records.

Dashboard maintained 5 concurrently managed, distinctly titled resumes during the session: 'Copy Person Resume', 'Startup Application Resume' (renamed from Untitled), 'Product Designer Resume' (minimal template), 'Marketing Manager Resume' (classic template), 'Software Engineer Resume' (modern template). Each is independently editable, renameable, and retains its own template/content, demonstrating support for managing multiple resume variations for different applications within a session.

Search 'marketing' (lowercase) correctly filtered to only 'Marketing Manager Resume'; search 'RESUME' (uppercase) matched all 5 titles containing 'resume', confirming case-insensitive title search. Clearing the search box restored all 5 resumes. Sort combobox 'Oldest First' reordered cards ascending by Updated date (Jan 20, 2024 first, Aug 25 2026 last); switching back to 'Newest First' restored descending order (most recent first). Additional Title A-Z/Z-A sort options also available.

issue: No UI control exists to filter resumes by exact creation date or date range
actual: The dashboard only offers a title-text search box and a sort combobox (Newest First/Oldest First/Title A-Z/Title Z-A). Entering a date value (e.g. '2024-02-10' or 'Feb 10, 2024', matching an actual resume's displayed 'Updated' date) into the search box returns 'No resumes found' rather than narrowing to matching resumes - the search only matches title text, not dates. No separate date-range or exact-date filter control is present anywhere on the dashboard.

issue: Resume data does not persist across a full application reload
actual: Before reload, the dashboard had 5 resumes including two created during the session ('Startup Application Resume', created via New Resume then renamed, and 'Copy Person Resume', a duplicate with an edited Full Name). After reloading the application (browser navigation to http://localhost:6005/), the dashboard reverted to only the original 3 seed resumes (Product Designer Resume, Marketing Manager Resume, Software Engineer Resume) - all newly created, duplicated, and renamed resumes were lost, and any edits made to those resumes during the session did not survive the reload.
